name: Pelargonium sidoides extract
description: Pelargonium sidoides extract (CAS 1175005-95-4 ), also marketed as African Geranium Extract, is a standardized botanical ingredient derived from the roots of a South African medicinal plant. It is sourced primarily for use in dietary supplements and pharmaceutical formulations targeting respiratory and immune health support. In nutraceutical product development, it is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and liquid supplements positioned around upper respiratory wellness. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use standardized extracts to formulate OTC preparations, particularly syrups and drops targeting bronchial and throat conditions. Food and beverage producers apply it in functional product lines where botanical antioxidant activity supports product differentiation and label claims. Its recognized flavoring profile also qualifies it for use in certain flavored supplement formats and herbal preparations where taste contribution is a formulation consideration. Pelargonium sidoides extract is supplied as a dry powder or liquid extract, with dry forms being the most common for supplement manufacturing. Standardized grades are available, typically characterized by defined polyphenol or umckalin content to support batch-to-batch consistency. Both food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications are available depending on the intended application and regulatory market. These materials are manufactured to meet rigorous quality standards, including USP and Ph.Eur. requirements where applicable for global distribution. The extract is valued for its high concentration of bioactive compounds, which are essential for maintaining the efficacy of the final product. Suppliers ensure that each batch undergoes strict testing to confirm purity and potency before it is released for industrial use. For manufacturers seeking reliable raw materials, this extract provides a versatile solution for health-focused product lines. Its long history of traditional use combined with modern standardization makes it a preferred choice for respiratory health formulations worldwide.
